title: Renaming Default renames every Default label but the badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Make sure Default has its original name, Default.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click Default's row.
  3. Click Default's name at the top of the page.
  4. Type Retail.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  7. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  8. Click Edit.
  9. Open tier A's rule picker.
  10. Click Cancel.
  11. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  12. Click Retail's row.
  13. Click Retail's name at the top of the page.
  14. Type Default.
  15. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Default is row 1.

Step 2:

  • Default's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 4:

  • The field reads Retail.

Step 5:

  • The title reads Retail.

Step 6:

  • The General Matrix still carries a badge reading Default.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A's second column is headed 1 · Retail.

Step 8:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 9:

  • The picker's group heading reads Off Retail price, above % Off and $ Off.

Step 10:

  • The grid returns to view.

Step 11:

  • Row 1 reads Retail.

Step 12:

  • Retail's page opens.

Step 13:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 14:

  • The field reads Default.

Step 15:

  • The title reads Default again.
